detail.another-job-started: Another scheduled job started in the same tick
detail.missed: Its time passed {lateness} ago, beyond a tolerance of {tolerance}
detail.filename-has-hash: The name contains #, and the gcode parser treats it as the start of a comment, so the name would be truncated
detail.filename-has-quote: The name contains a double quote, and the name is passed as a quoted gcode parameter, which a double quote would end early
detail.other-gcode-running: Something other than a print is running on the printer
detail.file-gone: {filename} is no longer on the printer
detail.start-not-seen-yet: The start has not shown up on the printer yet
detail.start-did-not-take: The printer accepted the start and then did not run it within {window}
detail.recorded-as-job: The printer recorded it as job {printer_job_id}
detail.running-with-no-history: The printer is running it, with no history entry yet
toolhead.material-unknown: The file does not say what material it needs
toolhead.slot-material-unknown: The file does not say what material slot {slot} needs
toolhead.none-free-with-material: No free toolhead has {material} loaded. The printer reports {loaded}.
toolhead.not-enough-of-material: This file needs {needed} with {material} and the printer has {held}. The printer reports {loaded}.
toolhead.cannot-give-each-its-own: The file's slots cannot all be given a toolhead of their own. The printer reports {loaded}.
refused.no-such-job: There is no job with that id
refused.not-settled-yet: This job is {state} and has not settled. Cancel it first.
refused.already-underway: This job is already {state} and cannot be changed. Schedule a new one from it instead.
refused.bed-not-promised: The printer cannot see the bed, so someone has to promise it will be clear
setting.ignored: {setting} is set to {found}, which cannot be used. Using {using}.
language.name: English
page.tagline: Start a print at a time you choose.
page.bed-will-be-clear: The bed will be clear. The printer cannot see it, so this is your word, not a check.
page.sign-in-again: The printer did not accept this request. Sign in to the printer's web interface in another tab, then reload this page.
page.finish-around-without-setup: should finish around {when}, not counting the printer's setup
page.finished-not-dismissed: A finished print has not been dismissed, so the bed is presumed occupied.
page.cancelled-not-dismissed: A cancelled print has not been dismissed, so the bed is presumed occupied.
page.printer-line: Printer status: {printer} A job may start up to {tolerance} late.
page.clocks-differ: This device's clock and the printer's differ by about {apart}. Times you pick are sent as an exact instant, so scheduling still works, but one of the two clocks is wrong.
page.no-material-stated: This file does not say what material it needs.
page.no-toolhead-tracking: This printer does not report what each toolhead holds, so the file's own tool numbering is used as it was sliced.
page.colour-mismatch: The nearest colour loaded is not the colour this file was sliced for: {slots}. The material matches, so it will print.
page.level-the-bed: Level the bed before this print
page.preferences-are-the-printer-s: These are the printer's own per-print settings, the same ones its app asks about. A plugin that forces one will override the choice made here.
page.starting-now: Starting now, waiting for the printer to pick it up
page.setup-then-printing: about {setup} of setup, then {printing} of printing
page.overlaps-with-an-earlier-job: An earlier job is projected to still be printing when this one is due, so this one would be cancelled as busy.
page.no-record-of-how-it-went: The printer has no record of how it went.
page.cannot-be-scheduled-see-above: This file cannot be scheduled as the printer is loaded. See above.
page.your-promise-about-the-bed: your promise the bed will be clear

page.held.one: The scheduler was not running for a while, so this job has not been started.
page.held.other: The scheduler was not running for a while, so these {count} jobs have not been started.

page.held-note: Nothing waiting will start until you confirm the schedule still says what you want. A job whose time has already gone will then be cancelled and say so.
page.showing-some-files: Showing {drawn} of {total}. Search to narrow it down.
page.start-help: Read in this device's timezone, {zone}, and sent to the printer as an exact instant.
refused.nothing-to-dismiss: There is nothing to dismiss: the printer now reports {state}.
detail.held-for-the-bed: Held because the printer still showed a {state} print, so it waits for somebody to confirm the bed is clear
detail.confirmed-start-now: You confirmed the bed was clear and asked for it to start now
refused.not-waiting-for-the-bed: This job is not waiting for the bed
refused.not-started-now: Nothing was started, and the job is still waiting for you. {why}
page.form-bed-warning: The printer still shows a finished print. Clear the bed and dismiss it now, or this job will wait for you when it is due.
page.held-for-the-bed: Waiting for you: the printer still shows a finished print.
page.held-for-the-bed-since-dismissed: Waiting for you: at {when} the printer still showed a finished print. It has been dismissed since, but the job does not start by itself.
page.cleared-start-now: I've cleared the bed, start it now
page.bed-clear-start-now: The bed is clear, start it now
